events.name: Low-stim Openings of the Audrey Amiss and Rudy Loewe exhibitions
events.blurb: Quieter, low-stimulation opening evening for the Audrey Amiss and Rudy Loewe exhibitions in Gallery 2, Thursday 19 November, 6–8pm.

events.name: On the Night of Separation, I Wanted to Tell You Something: Êvar Huseynî and WANAWAL
events.blurb: Interactive exhibition exploring how protest, music and celebration resist the erasure of language and national identity. Runs into March 2027. Check the listing for opening times.

events.name: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland
events.blurb: Seasonal winter festival with rides, food, markets and attractions. Runs from 19 November to 3 January. Check the official site for opening times and ticket prices before visiting.

events.name: The Hidden Corners of London with Jack Chesher
events.blurb: Bestselling author Jack Chesher uncovers London's secret stories, mysteries and forgotten history. Tickets from £12. Runs 19:00 to 20:30.

events.name: London Tarot Meetup for Black Women
events.blurb: Monthly-style tarot meetup for Black and Mixed-Black women to practise readings and connect. Price not listed; check the page.

events.name: Shōtengai pan-Asian Market
events.blurb: Monthly market turning Lower Stable Street into a Japanese-style street market with pan-Asian food and homeware. Runs Thu 19 to Sun 22 Nov. Free entry.

events.name: A Christmas Carol
events.blurb: The Three Inch Fools stage their supernatural take on Dickens' classic in the Chapel of St Peter and St Paul. Evening performances on 20 and 21 November at 7:30pm, lasting about two hours.

events.name: Peace Doves by Peter Walker
events.blurb: Peter Walker returns to the Painted Hall with Peace Doves, marking the 300th anniversary of the space. Runs 20 November 2026 to 7 February 2027. Check opening times before visiting.

events.name: In Conversation with Peter Walker: Art, Scale, and Collective Hope
events.blurb: An evening talk with the artist behind Peace Doves, held on its opening night in the Painted Hall. Runs 7pm to 8:30pm on Friday 20 November. Suited to adults interested in art and public installations.

events.name: Victorian Santa's grotto
events.blurb: Meet Santa at a Victorian-style grotto at London Museum Docklands and receive a gift. Good for young children. Runs 20 November to 23 December.

events.name: A Tale of Us
events.blurb: Gentle multi-sensory show for babies up to 18 months and a parent. Tickets come in pairs, with extra adult seats available. £9, about 35 minutes.

events.name: Robes SleepOut Entertainment
events.blurb: Evening of entertainment supporting the Robes Project SleepOut for people experiencing homelessness. £20 donation at the door. Runs 20:00 to 21:30.

events.name: 16th Annual Robes SleepOut
events.blurb: Give up your bed for one night to raise funds and stand with people experiencing homelessness in Southwark and Lambeth. Free to join; sponsorship encouraged.

events.name: Mission & Ministry | A Spiritual Tour of Southwark Cathedral
events.blurb: A guided look at the spiritual life and worship of this historic cathedral. Tickets from £7. Runs 11:00 to 12:00.

events.name: Friday Selector: Josh Malkin
events.blurb: Friday night selector set by Josh Malkin, running 20 and 21 November. Music-led night out. Price not listed; check the page for tickets.

events.name: Christmas Under the Canopy
events.blurb: Seasonal market of London artisan traders and food stalls. Free entry; starts 20 Nov, runs through December. Check the page for opening times.

events.name: Sea Shanty Festival at Cutty Sark
events.blurb: A day of shanty crews and singing workshops under the ship, 10am to 6pm, included with a Cutty Sark ticket.

events.name: Ceramics Workshop with Neve Beill: Turning London Clay into Pots
events.blurb: Introductory session with ceramicist Neve Beill, then a guided hands-on session making pots from London clay. Two hours, 1 to 3pm. Check listing for price.

events.name: Adult Garden Workshop
events.blurb: Second date of the adult garden workshop series, drawing on plants in the Horniman Gardens for hands-on practice. Check listing for times and booking.

events.name: Sea Shanty Festival 2026
events.blurb: A day of sea song performances and workshops at Cutty Sark, marking the tea clipper's 157th birthday. Free for Cutty Sark ticket holders.

events.name: Santa's Grotto relaxed session at the Queen's House
events.blurb: Quieter Santa grotto session designed for neurodivergent and SEND visitors. Pre-booking recommended. £30 per child or adult, plus booking fee.

events.name: Second World War family walk
events.blurb: Outdoor guided walk looking at the marks the Second World War left on London and the stories they tell. One date only, 21 November.

events.name: The Snowflake
events.blurb: A puppet show based on Benji Davies' Christmas story about a snowflake, a little girl and her Pappie. For everyone over 5. Opens 21 November and runs to 23 January 2027 at Little Angel Studios.

events.name: Meet Santa at London Zoo
events.blurb: Festive family experience with a chance to meet Santa at London Zoo. Runs until 24 December, so book ahead for a set slot.

events.name: Christmas at London Zoo
events.blurb: Seasonal festive activities across the zoo from late November into early January. Good for a family day out with winter lights and themed fun.

events.name: Guided Tour of Southwark Cathedral
events.blurb: Hour-long guided walk through over 900 years of the cathedral's history. Tickets £9. Good for weekend sightseeing and history fans.

events.name: Collectors Showcase
events.blurb: Vendors and fans meet to buy, sell and celebrate collectibles. A good browse for hobbyists in The National Hall.

events.name: Markfield Beam Engine open day (22 Nov)
events.blurb: Free open day at a restored 1886 Victorian beam engine by the River Lee. Engine steams at 12:30 and 2:30. Guided tours, family activities, café and playground. Donations welcome.

events.name: Christmas Wreath Making Workshop
events.blurb: Hands-on Christmas wreath making session to get into the festive spirit early. Price not listed; check the page before booking.

events.name: Extended Skate Sessions
events.blurb: Extended 90-minute skate session on the outdoor rink in the courtyard. Book ahead, as sessions sell out. This listing covers the 23 November session.

events.name: Lunchtime Organ Recital (Mon 23 Nov)
events.blurb: Free 30-minute lunchtime organ recital, held most Mondays. Drop in for a quiet midday break.
